name: grandis-legacy-pvp
description: Grandis Legacy PvP v3.80.16 — committed Mana is spent immediately before reactive Response windows, Response payment can be canceled before PAY, and battle VFX waits for authoritative target geometry while SFX stays low-latency.

scripts.check:syntax: node --check server.js && find server public tests tools -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.cjs' \) -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 -r -n1 node --check
scripts.test: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:authority && npm run test:mana-ui && npm run test:transport && npm run test:handshake && npm run test:assets && npm run test:lobby
scripts.release:seal: npm run test && npm run frontend-manifest && npm run manifest && npm run verify:manifest && npm run check:deployment
scripts.verify:deployment: npm run check:deployment && npm run test:startup

grandisLegacyArchitecture.referenceArchitecture: VS AI Tutorial v6.48 ↔ PvP v3.51 handshake concepts; current Mana interaction follows VS AI v6.91.6 exact replacement behavior with a center-only UI draft and final-UID PvP commit seam
grandisLegacyArchitecture.serverAuthority: VS AI v6.91.6 shared gameplay engine executed headlessly in Node VM; browser payment clicks hold only an ephemeral UI draft, and PvP validates final selected Shard UIDs at PAY before calling donor commit once
grandisLegacyArchitecture.pvpManaPayment: VS AI v6.91.6 exact-selection UX (including exact replacement and normal-Mana preference) is represented by a centered ephemeral UID draft; PAY sends final selected Shard UIDs once for authoritative validation and donor commit
